notes: Ground truth is used only in this aggregate offline evaluation.
Deterministic thresholds are fixed without fitting labels; anomaly training ends before the held-out period.
Supply peers use the analysis snapshot; this is retrospective screening, not a prospective replay.
Injected scenarios may be easy to detect; results do not estimate real-world fraud performance.
Claim baselines use K=100 claims; final capacity ranking uses K=10 cases. Their precision values are not directly comparable.
Citation and unsupported-claim metrics are populated separately by controlled tests.
